acceptance.processing: Exact runtime-decoder bufferView readback; unchanged accessors, scene/materials/transforms; finite original attributes; source/output SHA256; no vertex/triangle/corner reordering or removal.
acceptance.beneficial: Whole output GLB.gzip smaller than existing source GLB.gzip; all non-beneficial attempts retained.
acceptance.approval: Separate six-gate review required. Visual, current physical context, collisions and device performance stay untested.
acceptance.publication: Private staging only; no runtime catalogue or source assets changed.
